name: je-payroll
description: Jersey employer payroll and Income Tax Instalment Scheme duties for 2026, including employer registration, effective-rate notices, employee deductions, combined employer returns, payment and year-end reporting. Use for Jersey ITIS, missing effective rates, long-term care deductions, payroll returns or employer social security. Separates tax-only and combined defaults, contribution earnings, withholding collected from employees from the employer's own contributions and the employee's final assessment. Includes hypothetical notice, rounding and gross-pay examples. Benefits, directors, contractors and special arrangements need their specific rules. This source-cited draft awaits professional review. It cannot generate an effective rate or a complete operational payroll package.
